title: From Gin's Book. What the Dead Become

blocks.p: Rei read until the lamp was the only light in the flat. Gin's chapter on spirits was long, and it was the gentlest thing in the archive. He kept thinking of the widow's husband in his work jacket, knocking from inside the lacquer at the hour he died. These are the pages he copied out by hand that night, so that he would remember them in his own writing.

doc.title: Gin's preface, Chapter 10
lines: Most of the spirits I clear now trace back, if you follow them far enough, to water. The 2011 dead who were never found got no grave, no name read aloud, no place for the living to set them down... and a soul without any of that does not always understand it is meant to go.
Reconstruction gave the coast its houses back. It could not give those souls the one thing that lets a person cross. Being properly let go of.
The Division dislikes this framing. I have stopped minding what the Division likes.
G.U.

doc.title: CVD Entity Classification Reference. Chapter 10. Spirits. What Spirits Are
lines: Spirits are souls that crossed over with their essential structure intact... personality, relational identity, accumulated experience. They are still, in important ways, persons.
You are dealing with someone, not something.

The elderly woman in the Jujo building who had been anchored to her kitchen for eleven years after her death was not a threat. She was lonely and confused and the current tenants were rearranging her furniture. The resolution took four sessions and required me to learn that her late husband had always handled the filing. This is representative of approximately thirty percent of spirit cases.
A spirit can grow. A spirit can change. A spirit's feeding register is set at crossing, the dominant emotional register active at the moment of death.

The most common error in spirit work is biographical bias. The good spirit of a cruel person is still a good spirit. The bad spirit of a kind person is still a bad spirit. You are not dealing with the person. You are dealing with what became of the person after the crossing.

doc.title: Spirit Classification. Quality Spectrum
lines: High / Good. Personality intact and oriented toward the living in a way that produces benefit. Feeds on love, wonder, joy. The rarest, and the most important to protect.
Neutral / Stable. Personality intact. Anchored to a place, a person or an unresolved matter. The majority of spirits in field work. The work is about the anchor.
Low / Troubled. Not malice, but damage. Feeds on grief, fear, shame, and its presence makes the room worse for everyone in it. Responds to address of its own distress better than to removal.
Malevolent / Bad. Oriented toward causing harm deliberately. The malevolence was present before and survived the crossing. Rare.
Troubled spirits need help, malevolent spirits need removal. Confusing the two is one of the most consequential assessment errors in spirit work.

doc.title: Margin, in Gin's hand
lines: Troubled spirits cannot manage their presentation. They are too occupied with their own distress.
A spirit that becomes calmer, warmer, more helpful when someone with assessment capability enters the room is not troubled. It is managing you.
A troubled spirit gets louder when you look at it. It cannot help this.
I have gotten it wrong once in six years.

doc.title: Spirit Types. Field Documentation
lines: Spectral. Non-possessing. Stays on the veil side and reaches the living through feeling, peripheral sight, small moved objects. Most of my work. Most close as resolutions, not exorcisms.
Cohabitation. A good spirit in a willing host, with full awareness and consent on both sides. The CVD does not formally recognise it and treats any possession as an adverse event.
Troubled. Harm without intent. The spirit feeds on distress, its presence amplifies distress, and the loop escalates for months.
Invasion. A malevolent spirit in a host without consent, farming distress. The host is present for their own possession, aware of the wrongness, unable to stop it.

Anchored. The haunting. Held in place by something unresolved, sometimes grief, sometimes a commitment, sometimes a misunderstanding about its own death. The spirit was not waiting for permission to go. It was waiting for someone to notice it could not.
High spirit, approaching return. Moving toward the Font of its own accord. Practitioner role. Witness. Do not try to hold them.

doc.title: Case 7-114. Kenji
lines: His wife had been his partner for fifty-three years. When he crossed, he did not leave. He did not leave because he was not ready to leave and because she did not want him to leave.
She is eighty-one. He is whatever spirits become when they are sustained by love for half a century.

I drank the tea. I said goodbye to the empty chair. I closed the case as stable cohabitation. They are fine. Both of them. I am aware that this is not the official position. The official position is wrong about this case.

doc.title: Spirit vs Demon Possession. The Critical Distinctions
lines: Preparation. Demon, extensively prepared, weeks to months of monitoring, the possession was planned. Spirit, variable, often opportunistic.
Host consciousness. Demon, suppressed but present, surfaces for seconds, aware of everything and able to stop nothing. Spirit, more accessible, surfaces more often.
Fusion depth. Demon, deep and progressive, the partial state is a stage, not a stable endpoint. Spirit, shallower, a presence alongside rather than a fusion.
Removal. Demon, must be convinced or forced to withdraw, no standard protocol, every case specific. Spirit, stabilise the host and support the host's own resistance.
The first question in any possession assessment is not how do I remove this. It is what is this.

blocks.p: Rei read that last line three times. Then he turned the page and found the part of the chapter Gin had clearly loved writing.

blocks.cap: Spirits held in objects, the soul-vessels Gin describes

doc.title: Soul-Vessels. When a spirit chooses the object instead of the Font
lines: Every spirit that crosses has the same moment. The membrane opens. The Font is there. What the Font offers is completion. Most spirits take it.

At the moment of crossing, a spirit can choose an object instead. An object they loved, or made, or carried long enough that their frequency is already in it. The spirit becomes the object, fully, and has the personality of the person, the function of the medium, and one intent. Just one. The thing they cared about most. That one thing, they can do forever.
The CVD does not have a classification for this. The Grid calls them soul-vessels, or sometimes the old word, nusi.

I have documented eleven soul-vessels in the Kita district in six years. The CVD's official estimate for the city is thirty-seven. Their methodology does not include objects that have been sold out of the original family.
A cardiologist who chose a stethoscope might hear every lie as an irregularity in the speaker's chest. A locksmith who chose a key ring can open any lock in the city.

Soul-vessels communicate through their medium. A radio through stations, songs and interference. A book through passages that seem newly relevant. A knife through where it points. The soul-vessel cannot simply speak.

doc.title: Case 14-09. The Radio. Active contact / Cooperative / High operational value
lines: A Panasonic RF-2200 shortwave radio, manufactured 1973, found in a police substation storage room in my second year. The clearance team flagged it as register anomaly, non-threatening, and moved on. I stayed.

The radio is Takeshima Hideo, 54, retired traffic division officer, died 2001 of a heart attack in the Kita substation. His intent is information integrity. He cannot tolerate a false report going uncontested in his district.

He monitors the veil frequency of Kita the way he monitored the traffic frequency for twenty-three years. A specific chord progression means entity activity. A specific broadcaster's voice means a practitioner is in danger. When there is an active incident, he replays news broadcasts from dates that rhyme with it.

It took me two years to learn him. He plays comedic songs when I misread a situation, which I take as correction. He has warned me of three significant incidents before my equipment registered them. He identified a false-register contact in the district several weeks before I had evidence.

Rei. If you are reading this, the radio is in the evidence archive on the third shelf, marked Case 14-09, retain. Do not let anyone clear it. Ask him about the contacts that read as something other than what they present as. He will tell you through whichever station is on.

blocks.p: Rei sat very still when he reached his own name. A false-register contact. A thing that read as something other than what it presented as. His brother had known, months before the fourteenth, that something in Kita was wearing the wrong face. And he had left a dead traffic officer on a shelf in the CVD basement to say so when he could not.

He thought again of the widow. Her husband had knocked for four years, and that sounded like an anchored spirit, a man held by something he could not finish. Gin's own page said what such a spirit needed. Someone to notice. Then a witness, and a letting go. Given rest, both of them. It might have been a leave-taking. It might have been something else that only looked like one. The archive did not say, because the hand that wrote the ledger was no longer the hand that wrote the archive.
